images.prompt: Create ONE wide16:9 complete Japanese anime scene for a FIRST-PERSON FOOD SCIENTIST GAME. The supplied image is reference ONLY for the Japanese male mentor's canonical FACE and flat anime drawing. Keep Ren Takahashi's large dark brown anime eyes, clean-shaven face, simple black hair under pale blue food-lab cap, closed white laboratory coat/indigo collar/navy trousers. Upright and directly addresses lens, modest friendly smile, plain clipboard tucked under left arm, free hand relaxed. Redesign the ROOM into an unmistakable, exceptionally well-designed flagship FOOD PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT LABORATORY, with the luxury and sophistication of an award-winning research institute. This must show the actual workplace for formulation and texture testing, not a domestic kitchen, cafe, hotel, lounge, medical lab or chemistry fantasy. Beautiful high double-height ceiling with sculptural pale ivory acoustic coffers and integrated linear lights; tall slim-framed windows along LEFT with a single courtyard tree and pale brick research building outside; deep sage wall of seamlessly fitted laboratory cabinetry along BACK; upper clerestory; brushed stainless workbench/island RIGHT with rounded solid edge, one analytical balance near end and one recognisable benchtop texture analyser with vertical probe at far end. REAR RIGHT a separate pilot preparation bay with bench mixer, compact pilot oven and a beautifully integrated stainless extraction canopy. Enclosed ingredient storage, a separate hand-wash basin near entry; two neatly covered oat-snack sample trays and stainless bowl on bench. No plants or wood on food-contact worktops. Pale warm architectural stone-look cleanable wall panels, seamless ivory floor, smoked glass partition to distant sensory-testing room. Refined joinery, equipment integrated rather than piled up, excellent sightlines and generous functional clearance. Explicit layered spatial composition foreground workbench / mentor midground / pilot kitchen and glazing distance. Opulent through scale, thoughtful detailing, material contrast and architectural rhythm, NOT gold ornaments or hotel props. ENVIRONMENT RENDERING: painted 2D anime production background with medium selective architectural detail. Broad clean material colour masses, simplified crisp contours, a few soft painted gradients for depth. ONE or TWO broad restrained reflection bands on steel, NO mirror-like multi-reflections, no grain/pore/noise texture, no photo or archviz look, no tiny screws, no hundreds of jars, no individually drawn leaves. Keep important real equipment recognisable using silhouette, not microdetail. Soft morning sun from LEFT, warm light planes and cool shaded planes, subtle soft sun shaft near window where plausible. Match light on person and room. Face stays simpler/flatter than architecture: tiny nose mark, short line mouth, one broad cel shadow, sparse folds. Full plausible figure through knees and complete floor behind UI. No letters, text, numbers, logo, UI, border, collage or contact sheet.
